values.note: Reopened after the Hurricane Isaias closure: 'Effective October 20, 2026, all campgrounds that were closed due to Hurricane Isaias have reopened except for Coldwater Equestrian Campground and Clear Creek Campground.' Trails and other recreation areas stay closed for debris removal; the Karick Lake Loop Trail is 'closed until further notice'.

status.source: https://www.fdacs.gov/Forest-Wildfire/Our-Forests/State-Forests/Blackwater-River-State-Forest ('Effective October 20, 2026, all campgrounds that were closed due to Hurricane Isaias have reopened except for Coldwater Equestrian Campground and Clear Creek Campground. Further, with the exception of the Krul Boardwalk Trail, all other trails and Recreation Areas remain closed as debris removal and cleanup efforts continue this week.') + ReserveAmerica park page ('Attention: The Karick Lake Loop Trail is closed until further notice.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com campsiteDetails.do, parkId 1120110, all 14 sites ('Electricity Hookup: 30/50', 'Water Hookup: Y'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14 paved back-in RV-or-tent sites; max vehicle length 38-65 ft (one 65, one 55, the rest 38-47), and the tow vehicle counts in the length. Up to 8 people and 2 vehicles per site; 1 RV with 1 tent or 3 tents.

sites.source: floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com campgroundDetails.do + campsiteDetails.do, parkId 1120110 ('Max Vehicle Length' 38-65, 'Back-In', 'Driveway Surface: Pavement', 'Max Num of People: 8', 'Max Num of Vehicles: 2'; alert 'Vehicles pulling a camper must be included in the total length of the unit when selecting sites'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: ReserveAmerica park page ('Restrooms with showers are available') + campsiteDetails.do ('Water Available: Potable') + FDACS recreation areas page (South Karick Lake Recreation Area facilities 'Boat ramp', 'Restrooms and showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance.' The Florida Forest Service closes all state forest campgrounds when the county is under a tropical storm or hurricane warning, refunding reservations automatically.

booking.source: floridastateforests.reserveamerica.com campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=FLFS&parkId=1120110 (Booking Window 'Wed Oct 21 2026 - Tue Sep 21 2027 Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'; 'Important Notice: The Florida Forest Service will close all campgrounds and recreation areas on State Forests if the county where the State Forest is located is placed under a Tropical Storm or Hurricane WARNING'), read 2026-10-21

note: Florida Forest Service campground at the south end of Karick Lake (Okaloosa County), separate from Karick Lake North. Boat ramp + pier (electric motors only, no swimming). South Karick is in a non-hunting zone; wear orange when hiking away from it from Thanksgiving to mid-February. --Claude
summary: FDACS + FLFS ReserveAmerica (every site's details): confirmed 14 sites, 30/50-amp + water, 65-ft max, ReserveAmerica. Added status open (reopened 2026-10-20 after the Isaias closure), back-in only, showers + potable water, year-round, 11-month same-day window. Fees ($22.12) left as read 10-10. Note cleaned of hookup/length/booking text. Not stated: max stay; the FFS senior/veteran/disabled discount is offered 'at applicable camping facilities', not named for this one.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: ReserveAmerica marks 7 of the 14 sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (siteIds 1202, 1204, 1206, 1208, 1210, 1212, 1214; site 001 among them); the entry says lakeview.

Hurricane Isaias: Blackwater River SF's campgrounds reopened 2026-10-20 except Coldwater Equestrian and Clear Creek (FDACS banner); recorded status open. The campground is in Okaloosa County, not Santa Rosa.
